data.syncRules:
config:
  edition: 3

streams:
  team_match_events:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_events.*
      FROM match_events
      WHERE match_events.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_match_reviews:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_reviews.*
      FROM match_event_reviews
      WHERE match_event_reviews.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_match_observations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_observations.*
      FROM match_event_observations
      WHERE match_event_observations.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_match_memberships:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_memberships.observation_id AS id,
             match_event_memberships.canonical_event_id,
             match_event_memberships.projection_revision,
             match_event_memberships.created_at
      FROM match_event_memberships
      WHERE match_event_memberships.observation_id IN (
        SELECT match_event_observations.id
        FROM match_event_observations
        WHERE match_event_observations.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.event_id IN (
            SELECT events.id
            FROM events
            WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
          )
        )
      )

  team_match_operations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_operations.*
      FROM match_event_operations
      WHERE match_event_operations.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_match_projections:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_projection_state.match_id AS id,
             match_projection_state.revision,
             match_projection_state.input_digest,
             match_projection_state.rules_version,
             match_projection_state.confirmed_team_score,
             match_projection_state.confirmed_opponent_score,
             match_projection_state.provisional_team_score,
             match_projection_state.provisional_opponent_score,
             match_projection_state.possible_effects,
             match_projection_state.disciplinary_projection,
             match_projection_state.unresolved_review_count,
             match_projection_state.finalisation_state,
             match_projection_state.finalised_by_user_id,
             match_projection_state.finalised_at,
             match_projection_state.created_at,
             match_projection_state.updated_at
      FROM match_projection_state
      WHERE match_projection_state.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_matches:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT matches.id,
             matches.event_id,
             matches.shared_match_id,
             matches.competition_id,
             matches.opponent_name,
             matches.is_home,
             matches.team_score,
             matches.opponent_score,
             matches.game_plan_id,
             matches.game_plan_snapshot,
             matches.opponent_squad_visibility,
             matches.team_color,
             matches.opponent_color,
             matches.clock_period,
             matches.clock_elapsed_ms,
             matches.clock_started_at,
             matches.clock_revision,
             matches.created_at,
             matches.updated_at
      FROM matches
      WHERE matches.event_id IN (
        SELECT events.id
        FROM events
        WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
      )

  team_match_events_metadata:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT events.id,
             events.team_id,
             events.title,
             events.status,
             events.scheduled_at,
             events.location
      FROM events
      WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))

  team_athletes:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT athletes.id,
             athletes.team_id,
             athletes.first_name,
             athletes.last_name,
             athletes.squad_number,
             athletes.position
      FROM athletes
      WHERE athletes.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
        AND athletes.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))

  team_match_squads:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT athlete_match_stats.id,
             athlete_match_stats.match_id,
             athlete_match_stats.athlete_id,
             athlete_match_stats.started
      FROM athlete_match_stats
      WHERE athlete_match_stats.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_opponent_squads:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT opponent_match_players.id,
             opponent_match_players.match_id,
             opponent_match_players.shirt_number,
             opponent_match_players.name,
             opponent_match_players.position
      FROM opponent_match_players
      WHERE opponent_match_players.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  team_match_clock_operations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_clock_operations.id,
             match_clock_operations.match_id,
             match_clock_operations.session_id,
             match_clock_operations.actor_user_id,
             match_clock_operations.period,
             match_clock_operations.elapsed_ms,
             match_clock_operations.running,
             match_clock_operations.base_revision,
             match_clock_operations.applied_revision,
             match_clock_operations.outcome,
             match_clock_operations.payload_hash,
             match_clock_operations.client_created_at,
             match_clock_operations.created_at
      FROM match_clock_operations
      WHERE match_clock_operations.match_id IN (
        SELECT matches.id
        FROM matches
        WHERE matches.event_id IN (
          SELECT events.id
          FROM events
          WHERE events.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND events.team_id IN (SELECT team_members.team_id FROM team_members WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id'))
        )
      )

  # Shared streams expose only the opposite participant's match sheet. The
  # participant and team membership subqueries are re-evaluated for each sync
  # bucket, so removing team_members revokes an already-issued sync token.
  shared_session_match_events:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_events.id,
             match_events.session_id AS match_id,
             match_events.session_id,
             match_events.side,
             match_events.team,
             match_events.event_type,
             match_events.minute,
             match_events.opponent_label,
             NULL AS detail,
             match_events.logged_by_user_id,
             match_events.manually_adjusted,
             match_events.client_request_id,
             match_events.period,
             match_events.match_elapsed_ms,
             match_events.lifecycle_status,
             match_events.projection_revision,
             match_events.created_at,
             match_events.updated_at
      FROM match_events
      WHERE match_events.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND match_events.event_type <> 'injury'
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_events.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_events.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_events.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_events.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_match_reviews:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_reviews.id,
             match_event_reviews.session_id AS match_id,
             match_event_reviews.session_id,
             match_event_reviews.canonical_event_id,
             match_event_reviews.observation_ids,
             match_event_reviews.review_version,
             match_event_reviews.reason,
             match_event_reviews.status,
             match_event_reviews.resolution,
             match_event_reviews.resolved_by_user_id,
             match_event_reviews.resolved_at,
             match_event_reviews.disputed_by_user_id,
             match_event_reviews.disputed_at,
             match_event_reviews.created_at,
             match_event_reviews.updated_at
      FROM match_event_reviews
      WHERE match_event_reviews.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND match_event_reviews.canonical_event_id IN (SELECT match_events.id FROM match_events WHERE match_events.event_type <> 'injury')
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_event_reviews.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_event_reviews.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_event_reviews.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_event_reviews.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_match_observations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_observations.id,
             match_event_observations.session_id AS match_id,
             match_event_observations.session_id,
             match_event_observations.side,
             match_event_observations.logged_by_user_id,
             match_event_observations.event_type,
             match_event_observations.team,
             match_event_observations.opponent_label,
             match_event_observations.period,
             match_event_observations.match_elapsed_ms,
             match_event_observations.client_created_at,
             match_event_observations.server_received_at
      FROM match_event_observations
      WHERE match_event_observations.session_id IS NOT NULL
          AND match_event_observations.event_type <> 'injury'
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_event_observations.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_event_observations.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_event_observations.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_event_observations.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_match_memberships:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_memberships.observation_id AS id,
             match_event_memberships.canonical_event_id,
             match_event_memberships.projection_revision,
             match_event_memberships.created_at
      FROM match_event_memberships
      WHERE auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_event_memberships.observation_id IN (
        SELECT match_event_observations.id
        FROM match_event_observations
        WHERE match_event_observations.session_id IS NOT NULL
          AND match_event_observations.event_type <> 'injury'
          AND match_event_observations.session_id IN (
            SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
            FROM match_session_participants
            WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
              AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                SELECT team_members.team_id
                FROM team_members
                WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
              )
          )
          AND match_event_observations.match_id IN (
            SELECT matches.id
            FROM matches
            WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_event_observations.session_id
              AND matches.is_home IN (
                SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                         WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
                FROM match_session_participants
                WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_event_observations.session_id
                  AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                  AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                    SELECT team_members.team_id
                    FROM team_members
                    WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                  )
              )
          )
      )

  shared_session_match_operations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_event_operations.id,
             match_event_operations.session_id AS match_id,
             match_event_operations.session_id,
             match_event_operations.actor_user_id,
             match_event_operations.operation_type,
             match_event_operations.target_observation_ids,
             match_event_operations.canonical_event_id,
             match_event_operations.causal_parent_ids,
             match_event_operations.decision,
             NULL AS reason,
             match_event_operations.schema_version,
             match_event_operations.created_at
      FROM match_event_operations
      WHERE match_event_operations.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND match_event_operations.canonical_event_id IN (SELECT match_events.id FROM match_events WHERE match_events.event_type <> 'injury')
        AND (match_event_operations.operation_type = 'merge' OR match_event_operations.operation_type = 'separate')
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_event_operations.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_event_operations.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_event_operations.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_event_operations.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_match_projections:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_projection_state.match_id AS id,
             match_projection_state.session_id,
             match_projection_state.revision,
             match_projection_state.input_digest,
             match_projection_state.rules_version,
             match_projection_state.confirmed_opponent_score AS confirmed_team_score,
             match_projection_state.confirmed_team_score AS confirmed_opponent_score,
             match_projection_state.provisional_opponent_score AS provisional_team_score,
             match_projection_state.provisional_team_score AS provisional_opponent_score,
             match_projection_state.possible_effects,
             match_projection_state.disciplinary_projection,
             match_projection_state.unresolved_review_count,
             match_projection_state.finalisation_state,
             match_projection_state.finalised_by_user_id,
             match_projection_state.finalised_at,
             match_projection_state.created_at,
             match_projection_state.updated_at
      FROM match_projection_state
      WHERE match_projection_state.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_projection_state.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_projection_state.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_projection_state.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_projection_state.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_match_clock_operations:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_clock_operations.id,
             match_clock_operations.match_id,
             match_clock_operations.session_id,
             match_clock_operations.actor_user_id,
             match_clock_operations.period,
             match_clock_operations.elapsed_ms,
             match_clock_operations.running,
             match_clock_operations.base_revision,
             match_clock_operations.applied_revision,
             match_clock_operations.outcome,
             match_clock_operations.payload_hash,
             match_clock_operations.client_created_at,
             match_clock_operations.created_at
      FROM match_clock_operations
      WHERE match_clock_operations.session_id IS NOT NULL
        AND auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_clock_operations.session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
        AND match_clock_operations.match_id IN (
          SELECT matches.id
          FROM matches
          WHERE matches.shared_match_id = match_clock_operations.session_id
            AND matches.is_home IN (
              SELECT CASE match_session_participants.side
                       WHEN 'home' THEN false ELSE true END
              FROM match_session_participants
              WHERE match_session_participants.session_id = match_clock_operations.session_id
                AND match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
                AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
                  SELECT team_members.team_id
                  FROM team_members
                  WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
                )
            )
        )

  shared_session_report_state:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT match_sessions.id,
             match_sessions.home_confirmed_at,
             match_sessions.away_confirmed_at,
             match_sessions.finalised_at
      FROM match_sessions
      WHERE auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND match_sessions.id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )

  shared_session_report_sheets:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT session_report_sheets.id, session_report_sheets.shared_match_id AS session_id, session_report_sheets.clock_period, session_report_sheets.clock_elapsed_ms, session_report_sheets.clock_started_at, session_report_sheets.clock_revision, session_report_sheets.updated_at
      FROM matches AS session_report_sheets
      WHERE auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND session_report_sheets.shared_match_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )

  shared_session_report_fixture_scores:
    auto_subscribe: true
    query: |
      SELECT competition_fixtures.id, competition_fixtures.shared_session_id, competition_fixtures.home_score, competition_fixtures.away_score, competition_fixtures.status
      FROM competition_fixtures
      WHERE auth.parameter('two_sided_live_logging') = 'true'
        AND competition_fixtures.shared_session_id IN (
          SELECT match_session_participants.session_id
          FROM match_session_participants
          WHERE match_session_participants.team_id = auth.parameter('team_id')
            AND match_session_participants.team_id IN (
              SELECT team_members.team_id
              FROM team_members
              WHERE team_members.user_id = auth.parameter('user_id')
            )
        )
